module_summary: AXI4 to narrower AXI-lite bridge: skid-buffered bursts are split by beat counters into sub-word AXI-lite transactions, with ID/last FIFOs merging B responses and reassembling wide read data.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI4 write address request entering the AW skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Wide AXI4 write data entering the W skid buffer for downsizing

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.skids_wvalid
anchors.why: Buffered write-beat valid that advances slave beat counters and master valids

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.skids_awready
anchors.why: Pops AW skid buffer on last write beat of a burst

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.slv_awlast
anchors.why: Marks last slave write beat, gating acceptance of next AW burst

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.slv_wlen
anchors.why: Remaining slave write beats in current AXI4 burst; zero means idle

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.slv_awaddr
anchors.why: Current slave burst address, stepped via axi_addr next-address calculator

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.slv_awsize
anchors.why: Latched burst size deciding how many master beats per slave beat

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.next_slv_beats
anchors.why: Computes master sub-beats needed for first slave beat from size and address

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.slv_wready
anchors.why: Write backpressure: master beats drained and B FIFO not full

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.mst_awbeats
anchors.why: Counts remaining AXI-lite AW sub-beats; steps master write address

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.mst_wbeats
anchors.why: Counts remaining AXI-lite W sub-beats; clears master write valid

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: AXI-lite write address driven from mst_awaddr sub-beat address register

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write address valid from m_awvalid register

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.slv_wdata
anchors.why: Holds wide write beat, shifted down one master width per accepted W beat

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Narrow AXI-lite write data taken from low bits of slv_wdata

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write data valid from m_wvalid register

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.bfifo_write
anchors.why: Writes ID/last/subcount record into B-ID FIFO per slave write beat

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.read_from_wrfifo
anchors.why: Pops B-ID FIFO when a new response group starts

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.bcounts
anchors.why: Counts outstanding AXI-lite B responses to merge into one AXI4 response

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.b_return_stall
anchors.why: Stalls B response intake when final S_AXI_B response is blocked

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.bresp
anchors.why: Accumulates worst-case response across merged AXI-lite B responses

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.blast
anchors.why: Last-of-burst flag from FIFO deciding when S_AXI_BVALID fires

anchors.name: WDN.IMPLEMENT_WRITES.skidm_bvalid
anchors.why: Buffered AXI-lite B response valid driving response counting

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Merged AXI4 write response valid from s_axi_bvalid

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI4 read address request entering AR skid buffer

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.skids_arready
anchors.why: Pops AR skid buffer once current read burst is fully issued

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.slv_rlen
anchors.why: Remaining slave read beats of AXI4 burst; gates AR acceptance

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.slv_araddr
anchors.why: Current slave read address stepped by axi_addr per slave beat

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.slv_arready
anchors.why: Advances slave read beat when master sub-beats are drained

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.mst_arbeats
anchors.why: Remaining AXI-lite AR sub-beats; increments master read address

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.mst_arsublast
anchors.why: Marks last sub-beat of slave beat, stored in read ID FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: AXI-lite read address from mst_araddr sub-beat register

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read address valid from m_arvalid; also writes read ID FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Narrow AXI-lite read data entering rskid skid buffer

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.read_from_rdfifo
anchors.why: Pops read ID FIFO as each AXI-lite read response is consumed

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.rfifo_end_of_beat
anchors.why: Marks last sub-beat, raising s_axi_rvalid for the assembled wide beat

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.rfifo_addr
anchors.why: Sub-word lane index placing narrow read data into wide word

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.next_rdata
anchors.why: ORs shifted narrow read data into the wide read word being assembled

anchors.name: RDN.IMPLEMENT_READS.s_axi_rresp
anchors.why: Accumulates worst read response across sub-beats of one wide beat

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Reassembled wide AXI4 read data from s_axi_rdata register

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI4 read data valid from s_axi_rvalid

groups.name: AXI4 write ingress skid buffers
groups.description: AW and W skid buffers buffering AXI4 write requests; AW popped on last beat

groups.name: Write burst splitter
groups.description: Beat counters splitting each wide AXI4 write beat into AXI-lite AW/W sub-beats

groups.name: Write data downsizer
groups.description: Shift register delivering wide write data one master-width slice per W beat

groups.name: B response merge
groups.description: B-ID FIFO and counters merging many AXI-lite B responses into one AXI4 response

groups.name: Read burst splitter
groups.description: AR skid buffer and beat counters issuing AXI-lite reads per sub-word of each burst beat

groups.name: Read data reassembly
groups.description: Read ID FIFO and lane-shift logic assembling narrow responses into wide AXI4 read beats
